rejected.not_json.sha256.json: The recovery checksum manifest is unreadable
rejected.other_backup.sha256.json: Recovery checksum manifest does not describe this backup
rejected.wrong_digest.sha256.json: The recovery backup checksum does not match its manifest
rejected.wrong_size.sha256.json: The recovery backup checksum manifest does not match its file size

restore_guide: Keep the encrypted backup and its checksum manifest on separate protected media. Install the matching LocalGateKeys package offline, verify the SHA-256 checksum, then use Verify recovery backup with both the independent backup password and the vault master password from backup time. Restore as a new profile first. Store both passwords separately from the backup media; losing the vault master password from backup time makes the encrypted backup unrecoverable. If the vault had a 24-word recovery phrase, that phrase can replace a forgotten master password for the restored vault only when the phrase is still in its sealed, separately stored record; the phrase is never written into a backup or this kit.
same_password_message: Use an independent backup password, not the vault master password
